title: Wildly Spicy Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A spicy and flavorful Mexican dish featuring chicken, galangal, and coconut cream, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the chicken to cook until browned
Add the galangal and taco seasoning to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Stir in the coconut cream and bring the mixture to a simmer
Reduce the heat to medium-low and let the mixture cook for 5 minutes
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chicken mixture onto a tortilla and topping with cheese, tomatoes, and cilantro
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy
Garnish with additional cilantro and cheese if desired
